$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F03 hero (H), front on and close, landscape: the photographer's crop is kept. The right temple's outer face shows end-on at the far left: its old print comes off (rebuilt along the face, which converges hard toward the back) and the GCD goes on as the temple's angle shows it, a narrow sliver near the hinge. The striped light panel mirrored in the right lens goes; the far temple seen through the left lens stays.

marks.name: old print and emblem on the right temple's face, end-on (inset from its edges)
